description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Goblin Glasswright, adding {C}{C}.
Cast a copy of Seething Song from exile by paying {2}{R} and unpreparing Blazing Firesinger.
When you cast that spell, Extus triggers, returning Goblin Glasswright from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve Seething Song, adding {R}{R}{R}{R}{R}.
Cast Goblin Glasswright by paying {1}{R}.
Goblin Glasswright enters prepared.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Blazing Firesinger, adding {C}{C}.
Cast a copy of Craft with Pride from exile by paying {R} and unpreparing Goblin Glasswright.
When you cast that spell, Extus triggers, returning Blazing Firesinger from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the copy of Craft with Pride, creating a Treasure token.
Cast Blazing Firesinger by paying {2}{R}.
Blazing Firesinger enters prepared.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.name: Extus, Oriq Overlord // Awaken the Blood Avatar
